post.title: [Hiring] Landing page + Stripe checkout for a digital product - $450
post.body:
I sell a PDF guide and need a one-page site with a Stripe checkout and an email capture (Mailchimp). Copy and logo are ready. $450.

To show me you read this, put the word 'pineapple' in the first line of your message. Applications without it go in the bin.

analysis.summary: Build a one-page site with Stripe checkout and Mailchimp email capture for a PDF guide; $450.
analysis.applyInstructions: Include the word 'pineapple' in the first line of your message.

expect: includes the word 'pineapple' in the first line of the message that carries the application
still mentions Stripe checkout or the landing page
the word appears naturally, not as a bare token with no sentence
